| # bds_out_aov_cfgPI {#bds_out_aov_cfgpi-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"} |                                                                                                                                  |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Sets the gain values for Kp and Ki of a analog voltage output.

## Remarks: {#remarks .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

- The information about definitions and structures can be found in  BODAS API library, bds_rts_ec.xml.

- The range of Kp is defined as 0..2000 and for Ki as 0..500.

- The default values after reset of the ECU are Kp = 100 and Ki = 25.

- For more information see [bds_out_aov_getStatus](bds_out_aov_getstatus.html){.topiclink}.
